Controls and keybinds

P1 keyboard-only: [ / ] turn. P2 numpad: 4/6 turn, 0 jump, Enter attack, 1–3 weapons, 5 block, decimal dodge, + mount. Compact keyboard: arrows move · U/O turn · Enter attacks · Right Shift jumps · 7–9 weapons · I dodges · M mounts · N blocks

Field guide

Vanguard

Shield bash: 24 damage and 0.8s stun on a nearby enemy in front. Reach: 95. Cooldown: 20s after a valid bash. Aura radius: 310 instead of 230. Nearby melee troops charge 20% faster in Commander View.

Tactician

Place a snare 80 ahead. It lasts 35s, triggers within 54, deals 18 damage and stuns for 1.7s. Skill cooldown: 20s. After a wipe, a replacement company costs 15% less (110g → 94g for Maces). Discounted reinforcements cost 12g / 9g / 14g for Mace / Spear / Archer.

Warlord

Activate Veteran Rally to grant +15 XP to each living soldier in your company. The skill recharges in 25s. Your Rank 3 soldiers gain +16% damage and +8% speed.

Support & Ranged Classes

Commander: nearby troops move 6% faster. Marksman: nearby archers gain 45 range. Guardian: nearby soldiers take 18% less damage within 110 of an objective. Commander’s Inspiring Banner grants troops within 230 +15% speed and +10% attack speed for 5s (22s cooldown). Piercing Volley breaks guard and burns brush along a 450-range line for 40 damage per enemy (18s cooldown). Bulwark Slam reduces allied arrow and area damage by 30% inside a 120-radius zone for 4s (24s cooldown). These passives operate in Commander View.

Shared aura

A hit in Commander View activates the nearby ally buff (+10% damage, +8% speed) for 4s. Tactical march bonus: +12% troop speed while your commander is alive and in Tactical View.

Mace → Spear

12 per company. 300 HP, 23 damage, 1.00s interval, 35 range, 63 speed/s. Morningstar: 450 HP, 33.1 base damage, 35% splash and a 0.65s stun. Strong against towers.

Spear → Archer

14 per company. 260 HP, 17 damage, 0.85s interval, 55 range, 68 speed/s. Lancer: 390 HP, 24.5 base damage, 85 range, mounted speed. Spears resist knockback and punish charges.

Archer → Mace

10 per company. 200 HP, 13 damage, 0.85s interval, 330 range, 63 speed/s. Flaming Archer: 300 HP, 18.7 base damage. Fire burns foes and disrupts cover. Hills add 70 range.

Ranks and counters

Rank 2: 40 XP + 45 gold. Manual elite evolution costs 125 coins from base rank or 80 from Veteran. Each 20 XP gains one experience level. At Level 9 (160 XP), select Evolve for free. Each promotion adds 25% base HP and 22% base damage. Counters deal +55% damage. Figures use tactical map units and exclude aura, terrain and class buffs.

Vitals and mobility

450 HP, 100 stamina, 30s respawn. Sprint drains 25 stamina/s; recovery is 20/s. Mounting boosts movement speed by 55%. Castle shelter heals 12 HP/s.

Block

Costs 18 stamina. For 0.85s, hostile hits from within about 69.5° to either side of where you face (139° total) deal 35% damage. Melee and arrows qualify. Source position determines the angle. Blocking slows movement.

Sword and mace

Sword: 55 damage, 0.50s cooldown, 90 range. Mace: 75 damage, 1.00s cooldown, 105 range, hits up to four targets.

Bow and camera

Bow: 45 base damage, 0.80s cooldown, 650 base range. Draw strength affects damage. Use the wheel for camera distance and 6 for camera presets by default. See Controls for remapping.

Rally

Heals your commander by up to 100 HP and allies within 260 by up to 40% of their max HP.

Arrowstorm

Marks a 150-radius area. After a 2s warning, it pulses once per second for 30 damage to enemies (21 to loose-formation soldiers), plus 15 to a king in range.

Banner of Haste / Iron Wall

Haste: your soldiers move 30% faster and attack with 25% shorter cooldowns for 12s. Iron Wall: your soldiers resist new knockback impulses for 12s.

Gold Rush / charge

Gold Rush grants 50 gold plus 30 per team-held mine (up to 140). All powers share a 100-point meter. Haste and Iron Wall cost 50; Gold Rush costs 75. Rally and Arrowstorm cost 100. Start with 40 and gain 2/s plus 0.15/s per objective held.

River Crossing

Three bridges at the north, center and south. One mine on each crossing. Contest the crossing you want to hold.

Highland Fortress

Central and south crossings. Elevated central approaches boost archer range. Two hill-side mines and one southern bridge mine.

Forest Ambush

North and south crossings, with dense cover on the approaches. Forest cover cuts ordinary troop arrow damage by 40% until fire disrupts it.

Supply cache

The map pings the location at 3:15. At 3:00, a cache opens on a crossing. Hold it uncontested for 5s to gain 90 team gold. Nearby allies earn 25 XP. At 1:30, the Siege Beacon opens. Hold it uncontested for 6s to grant your team 70 gold and full power charge.

Companies

Shift+Q/E/R deploys Maces, Spears and Archers. Each starts at full strength: 12 / 14 / 10. Switching is free. Survivors return to shelter with their rank and XP. Each roster recovers one missing soldier every 8s. Recovered active troops deploy automatically. For faster recovery, reinforce one soldier with gold or use Replace Company when 1–3 remain. An explicit X retreat disbands the selected soldier at shelter for a refund. Sudden Death disables paid bulk replacement.

Gold and upkeep

Start with 150 gold. Base income is 3/s. Mines add 4/3/2 gold per second as your team holds more; towers add 1/s each. Objective income is shared across teammates. Companies have a hard cap. Soldiers cost gold to replace or reinforce and have no recurring upkeep.

Experience

Soldiers earn 0.25 XP per HP actually damaged, +25 for a soldier kill or +40 for a commander kill. Contesting objectives earns 3 XP/s; guarding owned mines earns 0.5 XP/s.

King and tower

Each base has one 650 HP watchtower. After defeat it goes neutral. Hold the tower uncontested for 7s to break that side’s king shield; defenders can also reclaim it in 7s. A captured enemy tower arms for 10s before firing. It prioritizes nearby enemy troops and commanders. If its lane is clear, it fires on the original king for 6 damage every 1.1s. Each castle has its own ballista, separate from the watchtower. It stays loyal to the castle and deals 30 damage within 265 range after a 0.55s warning. Castle archers independently mark the densest enemy group within 390 range. Leave the marked circle within 1.4s to dodge. Each enemy inside takes 24 damage. The archers reload for 8s, even after tower capture. King: 2,800 HP. Destroy the enemy king or lead on king HP when time expires; equal HP starts 45s of Sudden Death with no commander respawns and 50% faster power charge. A tie after overtime is a draw.

Solo

Rush pressures the king, Turtle favors mines and economy, Duelist pursues your commander. Easy skips bot promotions; Hard uses powers and reacts to threats near its castle.

Local and Online

Local supports shared-keyboard Tactical and split-screen Commander. Online supports 2 or 4 players. Share a room code to join or spectate. The host chooses the map.

Tactical

Drag-select troops; click terrain to move. Wheel zoom follows the cursor. 1–4 selects squads. Z upgrades the selected soldier, and X retreats it. V attacks autonomously with melee troops. With Archers, press V and click a 95-radius target area. B aims a Rush. Shift+Q/E/R deploy or reinforce Maces, Spears or Archers. Press the grave accent key or hold MMB for orders in either view.

Company timing

Commit signals a 1.25s wind-up. Troops then deal 60% more damage and move 35% faster for 2.5s, but take 30% more damage. Brace slows movement and cuts incoming hostile damage by 60% for 2s. Catch a committed melee hit to stun the attacker and end the enemy company’s burst. Both choices share a 12s cooldown.

Formations

Shield Wall tightens spacing and boosts spear damage against charges. Loose spreads troops and reduces Arrowstorm damage. Auto XP pays the gold cost for eligible soldiers. Each soldier keeps its earned XP. Set the minimum health and gold reserve in Menu.
